title: One-Step Reachability Extension
statement: Let $A$ be a memory-register machine, let an oracle and input be fixed, and let $G$ be a property of configurations. If $G$ holds at a configuration $a$ and, starting from the one-step successor of $a$, the machine reaches $c$ in finitely many steps while satisfying $G$ at every configuration before reaching $c$, then it also reaches $c$ from $a$ while satisfying $G$ at every configuration before reaching $c$.
hypotheses_covered: The one-step successor of $a$ reaches $c$ along a finite run whose configurations before $c$ satisfy $G$
